lines:
حسب رسالة الذكرى السنوية الأولى
من نت إيز غيمز (NetEase Games)

خبر كبير في ديسمبر باسم Beyond
والتفاصيل لم تُكشف بعد

تعاون مع إنفيديا (NVIDIA)
لتكون من أوائل ألعاب DLSS 5

مواقع خوادم جديدة في
الشرق الأوسط خلال العام الماضي
headline:
خبر كبير في ديسمبر
من Where Winds Meet
label: رسمي
bed_reason: stills: no trailer stretch usable; Anniversary trailer opened (near-black opening, bloodied face and hand, burnt-in title cards) and Gameplay trailer opened (burnt-in subtitles, title cards, black frames, dialogue and narration); our bed under the stills

angle.hook: the first-anniversary letter of Where Winds Meet promises major news in December under the codename Beyond
angle.why_now: the letter went up on the official site on 13 to 14 Nov, hours before this Reel, and no Arabic outlet has carried it
angle.what_it_means_here: the letter lists the Middle East among the regions where new server nodes were added in the past year, though Steam lists no Arabic among the supported languages
angle.payoff: the December news is only a codename with no details, so nothing more than that is confirmed

tried: Steam Where Winds Meet Anniversary trailer (movie 257504353): near-black opening, bloodied face and hand, fire and war scenes, burnt-in title cards, unusable
Steam Where Winds Meet Gameplay Trailer (movie 257231667): burnt-in subtitles, title cards, black frames, dialogue and narration, unusable
official site anniversary letter page: text only, no video
